races.paceDynamic: Gameball, Leader d'Allier, and Nadia's Boy will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Ionian likely to join them early. This creates a sustained tempo that will test stamina reserves over the extended trip on yielding ground. The pace will be honest throughout, potentially quickening after the final flight as the prominent runners Colcannon and Fort Dino look to capitalize. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses and those who can finish, as the early pace will set up the race for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders maintain a strong gallop and tire late.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace on testing ground will find out the front-runners, allowing late-closing types to pick up the pieces. Horses like Immediate Effect and Beauvallon can time their runs perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Colcannon or Fort Dino get the perfect stalking position behind the leaders.
scenarios.body: They can track the pace without doing the donkey work, then strike when the leaders weaken. Their tactical positioning allows them to avoid both the early pace battle and the stamina-sapping effects of leading.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an easier lead than expected.
scenarios.body: Nadia's Boy or Leader d'Allier could dictate terms if the others don't go with them early. Their proven ability at this trip gives them the stamina to see out the race despite making the running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Techno Davis or Alwaysgoinhome have been well-prepared for this step up.
scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien stable excels with improving types, and both newcomers could have untapped potential. Their fresh legs and unknown ability make them dangerous if ready to strike.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Gameball and Leader d'Allier both go forward aggressively early - could set up a pace collapse
Monitor how quickly Immediate Effect and Beauvallon are produced - both need the race to develop late
Check if Techno Davis travels strongly throughout - could indicate a big performance is coming
Watch for any jumping errors from the front-runners as they battle for position over the hurdles

Diamond Du Berlais will need to overcome her hold-up style against what shapes as an honest gallop that could blunt late kicks. This race setup clearly favors front-running and prominent runners who can travel strongly in behind the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Future Prospect Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Future Prospect gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: Her class edge (OR 129, RPR 142) allows her to dictate ideal fractions before kicking clear, with Blue Velvet tracking into second from her prominent position. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the strong early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blue Velvet Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Velvet gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders without having to make the running
scenarios.body: She can use her prominent style to perfection, staying close to Future Prospect before striking decisively in the final half-furlong. Her fresh legs from tracking rather than leading prove decisive against the early pace makers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Alliteration Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration can match Future Prospect's early pace without folding
scenarios.body: Her recent winning form (13321) and lighter weight burden could see her outlast the classier Future Prospect in a sustained battle. The smaller field allows her to maximize her front-running style without interference.

races.paceDynamic: Vanillier is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested from the flag. With most runners preferring prominent or hold-up tactics, he'll face minimal early pressure and can control the tempo over this extended 4m1f trip. The lack of genuine pace-setters means Vanillier can build a comfortable lead before the business end, while the large field of hold-up horses will be scrapping for positions turning for home. This race shape heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can track Vanillier early, as the hold-up brigade will face a tough task making up ground against a controlled gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos

scenarios.body: A consistent stayer like Dorans Law or Bodhisattva can pick up the pieces. Both have shown recent form and prefer to come from behind when the pace collapses.

races.paceDynamic: Onewaywest is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the off, likely getting an uncontested lead in this large 26-runner field. With most rivals adopting hold-up or prominent tactics, the pace should be sustainable early with Hewick, Karl Des Tourelles, and Margaret's Legacy providing the closest early tracking positions. The tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the inevitable late stampede. This race shape clearly benefits horses with prominent running styles who can avoid trouble and have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains moderate and prominent runners get clear runs
scenarios.body: Onewaywest sets sustainable fractions allowing prominent trackers to pounce, while hold-up horses get caught in traffic in the large field. The race becomes a battle between those close to the pace who can quicken first.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or prominent runners falter
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses benefit from a strong gallop that brings them into contention, with the better stayers coming through late. Key hold-up runners need luck in running through the big field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Onewaywest gets easy fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The leader gets soft sectionals early and has enough left to repel challengers, with the chasing pack unable to make up the ground. This becomes a wire-to-wire victory for the confirmed pace-setter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early fractions are very slow and it becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The race turns into a cavalry charge from the back with pure speed decisive over stamina. This favours the freshest hold-up horses with the best turn of foot regardless of stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Escapeandevade and Dont Go Yet will dispute early honours as the two confirmed front runners, with Birdie Or Bust, Coral River and Relieved Of Duties pressing close behind in prominent positions. The large field and yielding ground conditions will create an honest pace throughout, with the leaders unable to steal a march but unlikely to collapse either. The combination of competitive pace and testing ground over 2m4f strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as the early leaders will have their stamina sapped by the conditions and distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves honest and the yielding ground takes its toll on the leaders
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will weaken in the straight as stamina reserves are tested, allowing fresh finishers to sweep past. This scenario perfectly suits the patient tactics and strong staying power of the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate with Escapeandevade and Dont Go Yet settling better than expected
scenarios.body: The race will become tactical, suiting horses who can track the leaders without overexertion then pounce late. Those in prominent positions can time their challenges perfectly without the energy-sapping early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survival
scenarios.trigger: If both main pace-setters compromise each other early and one breaks clear
scenarios.body: The survivor will gain crucial breathing space on the testing ground, building an unassailable lead. Only a front runner with proven stamina reserves can capitalize on such a scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Rising Late

scenarios.body: Superior class will overcome the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind on testing ground. The best horses will demonstrate their quality when it matters most in the closing stages.

races.paceDynamic: Quiryn, Bon Bon Fizz, Soul Asylum and Adaboy Mushy will ensure a strong gallop from the start with four confirmed front-runners in an 11-runner field. The pace will be genuinely testing throughout the 2m½f trip, with no obvious escape route for the leaders given the competitive nature of the field. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and create stamina pressure in the final half-mile. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Look Me and Bois d'Angos who can pick up the pieces late when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too fast early and weaken markedly
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop stretches the field badly and allows the closers to sweep up from the back. Look Me and Bois d'Angos are perfectly positioned to exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Horse Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can control fractions and stay on
scenarios.body: Quiryn or Soul Asylum could dictate terms and have enough left to repel late challenges. Their class and tactical speed gives them the edge over closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong but not suicidal
scenarios.body: Our Trigger and Outofafrika can track the leaders without getting involved in early speed duels. They get first run on the weakening pace-setters while avoiding traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical mess with false pace early
scenarios.body: The competitive nature creates stop-start fractions that suit an unconsidered runner. Cowboy Casanova or Highlander Addict could capitalize on others' tactical errors.
